paragraphs.text: Everyone wants to talk about the elephant in this room.
Known for their hit single "Your Wait from This Point Is Seven Hours."
"You will either begin or end the ride no taller than this."
It's not like anyone else really wanted it.
The Astrotorium's Clown-Bots are programmed to delight attendees by any means necessary.
You haven't seen it until you see it in 6-D.
The lucky armor stopped lightning and lasers, but sadly, also love.
"If people are always on the edge of their seats, we can save money on chair backs." —Myra the Magnificent
"Anna and Blaine said the ride was awesome. Yolanda and Zachary aren't back yet."
Once he stopped eating tickets, Bixby was a model employee.
"When riding Erebos's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."
"I AM FILLED WITH DELICIOUS CANDY. I AM NOT A TRICK."
Heinrich catches the trapeze only about half the time, but he looks so good falling.
"As long as there's no outside food, you're good to go."
Myra bought beebles because they were cheaper than rubber ducks. Now the infestation is her largest expense.
"All you gotta do is panic with purpose. And plead your innocence with purpose. And have your mom bail you out with purpose."
"I designed the Astrotorium's jetpacks to be lightweight and inexpensive. Nobody mentioned reliable." —Truss, chief engineer
To B, or not to B.
The largest dunk tank in forty-seven galaxies.
For extra style points, spin them.
Everyone comments on the buttons, but few appreciate the pedals.
"All you gotta do is walk with purpose. And run with purpose. And clear a five-foot gate with purpose."
"Glaxxar, Security Bot 254 has wandered off. After lunch, throw on a spacesuit and go find it." —Truss, chief engineer
Squawks was quick to establish the social pecking order.
"Code Dark Donut! Code Dark Donut! All available fun specialists, please report to the Roil Coaster immediately!" —Truss, chief engineer
Somehow only the third-most dangerous ride in the park.
Myra doesn't pay the vampires to smile—but only because guests found it off-putting.
Like any young zombie, Gary dreamed of escaping the underworld to join the circus.
Waiting is for chumps with flimsy spacesuits.
At the Astrotorium, even the dead make a living wage.
paragraphs.card: Night Shift of the Living Dead

paragraphs.text: While the gremlin, beeble, and squirrel infestations wreaked havoc on the park, Roxi was able to spin the numerous rat colonies as a "robust recycling program."
The audience always loves it, but volunteers are divided.
"Three tries to decide your fate! Fabulous prizes! Probably no untold torment!"
"Ah, the midway, beating heart of the—well, maybe the big top is the heart. If there were two hearts, then the midway—or the lungs. Lungs or stomach!" —Captain Rex Nebula
"And to think, I came in here looking for someone to eat."
"Hey Glaxxar, did you remember to seal the vents on the seat belt control module?" —Truss, chief engineer
"My Abattoir Ghoul deck is unstoppable. Wait, 1996 World Champion?" —Johnny, to Spike
Space can be a lawless place—far from the prying eyes of electrical inspectors.
There's no defending against public opinion.
Once he'd worked out which end of the thing the paint came from, he was promoted to shirt duty.
It's all fun and games until it drops a guest. Then it's a misdemeanor.
Programmed to play more than seventy instruments and only one song.
"Oooooh!" —The crowd "Aaaaaaaaah!" —Also the crowd

"Rent a scooter and be just like Devil K. Nevil! Just don't go faster than the speed limit. Or jump over anything. Or catch on fire. Or break every bone in your body multiple times. Other than that, just like him!"
Born to, and of, rock.
Nobody had ever won the bear, but then again, nobody had ever wanted it quite as much.
"What's the big deal? I've been on fire eighty-one times. Twice just while sleeping." —Devil K. Nevil, daredevil extraordinaire
"Whimsy overflow in sector G! The gremlins are rampaging and the beebles are on fire!"
Why did the chicken cross the park? To get to the other ride.
Punchy was programmed to do two things: punch tickets and love punching tickets.
"Flea circus? No, flee circus!"
What the show lacks in historical accuracy, it makes up for in awesome submission holds.
The milk bottle toss is closed until the rules can be amended.
"So sorry, but, per our waiver, we're not responsible for 'things happening.'"
"Don't worry about me, folks! This beauty was well-fed by my predecessor."
Can you do the can-can-can-can?
In hindsight, Chandra's Incendiary Experience should never have been built next to Auntie Grub's House of Pitch.
"Petting in the petting zoo is not advised." —Astrotorium waiver
The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.
Just be thankful it wasn't grammar scorpions.
Such plush accommodations.
The animal and vegetable categories kind of merged over time.
The voice of an angel. And the face of an angel. And the legs of... you get the idea.
The capo of caps, the hitman of hats, the don of donning fashionable headwear.
She'll sculpt goblins, saprolings, Marit Lage . . . though that one takes a *lot* of balloons.
As far as Lila was concerned, all courtesy should be common.
The goblin word for "vacation" translates roughly to "a battered landscape of noise and violence."
High-wire injuries are down 95%. Spider-related injuries are up 3000%.
Weighing in at a combined thirteen thousand pounds and two ounces.
"It was a pleasure to meet me." —Captain Rex Nebula
"YOU MUST BE THIS TALL TO RIDE. YOU HAVE TEN SECONDS TO COMPLY."
It's always up-to-date, so visitors know what rides are open, how long the lines are, and which areas are closed due to gremlins.
The glow of the big top can be seen for light years, but its excitement can be felt in the hearts of everyone who's ever been there.
"Here's a nice place we haven't hit yet." —Captain Rex Nebula
Buy enough balloons and it turns into a ride.
"INPUT ACCEPTED: SHIVAN DRAGON. INITIATING . . . ERROR! GIRAFFE. GIRAFFE. GIRAFFE."
There is a very real danger that the squeaking will rally nearby squirrels to battle.
"MY PRIMARY FUNCTION IS TO FOLD INFLATABLE TUBES INTO JOY."
The Astrotorium bouncing record is three days, though setting it wasn't strictly intentional.
It recreates the peaceful feeling of floating freely in space, just without all that boring peacefulness.
Anti-gravity. Pro-fun.
It's a raucous, ricochet-ridden romp, loosely based on the molecular movement inside exploding stars.
"These bumping cars remind me of the time your amusement park smashed into my planet." —Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop
Vehicular mischief's appeal is universal.
The cars are serviced every ten thousand bumps or every four hours, whichever comes first.
For those needing instructions how to drive the bumper cars, there's a crash course.
The engineers figured out a way to make the crashes power the ride itself. The energy surplus alone is enough to run the deep fryer.
"Pulled a Captain Nebula" —Crew expression meaning "an out-of-control car has caused great damage to the surrounding area"
Originally, the rotors were used exclusively as particle accelerators for engine fuel, and they probably still should be.
The back of each ticket features a map to the lost and found.
The sound it makes is indescribable and unsettling, but it does make a great clown.
One day, it will produce a clown that can itself produce a clown. Until that day, it will not rest.
Pietra's Mirthing Pod boasts an output that's hilarious and impressive—a real laugh a minute.
"CONGRATULATIONS. IT IS A CLOWN."
Eating here is always a concession.
"Days since last atomic ketchup explosion: 1." —Kitchen safety notice
Now serving Basri Kettle Corn, Taco Bolas, Karn Dogs, Koth of the Hamburger, Dovin Baan Mi, Oko Cola, Frozen Tamiyogurt, and more!
The Astrotorium offers fine dining at establishments such as Time Wok and Grilliana's.
Outfits you'll love at prices you'll tolerate.
Dress up like all your favorite Planeswalkers! And Oko.
"Chandra's Pyromastery Gloves are not fire resistant." —Costume warning label
Dressed to the 9/9s.
"Sold out I'm afraid, but Wrenns Three through Six are on sale." —Lonak, sales manager
"The costumes are so realistic! I was mistaken for Nicol Bolas and attacked by a bunch of wizards! Five stars! They eventually let me go." —*Salzon's Ride Review*
"I can see the next star system from here!"
In space, no one can hear you repeatedly beg to get off the ride.
Sixty stories above the Astrotorium, attendees often wonder if they've made a mistake. They have another two hundred stories to decide.
What goes up might come down.
The hardest working seat belts in the park.
"Um, technically you can't 'drop' in space. What you—AIIIIEEEEEEE!"
After a certain point, it becomes more of a prison than a ride.
Nothing is safe in the hands of an eight-year-old.
"As a safety measure, our foam is made from the softest metals available." —Randa, day care blacksmith
"I'm sorry, ma'am. Sometimes a real sword just sneaks its way in there." —Randa, day care blacksmith
Not suitable for children . . . who aren't ready to have a lot of fun!
TODAY'S FORTUNE: YOU WILL REGRET SPENDING YOUR MONEY ON THIS FORTUNE.
TODAY'S FORTUNE: TO AVOID CERTAIN DOOM, MAKE SURE TO . . . INSERT ADDITIONAL TOKENS TO CONTINUE.
TODAY'S FORTUNE: YOU WILL HAVE A CHANCE ENCOUNTER WITH A HANDSOME ROBOT.
TODAY'S FORTUNE: THE REST OF YOUR LIFE WILL BE FULL OF FUN AND HAPPINESS—ALL SIX HOURS OF IT.
TODAY'S FORTUNE: AVOID CHANDRA'S INCENDIARY EXPERIENCE AROUND 11:37.

TODAY'S FORTUNE: ON YOUR DEATHBED, YOU WILL REGRET NOT EATING MORE PIZZA. (This fortune brought to you by our sponsor Saheeli Pie Pizzeria, located on the boardwalk next to Teferi's Time Twister. Bring this fortune to get 15% off any purchase.)
For a smaller fee, you can pop in quickly to try on a pair of jeans.
"Finally! Something that can capture all my good angles." —Captain Rex Nebula
To build Sorin's Haunted Mansion, every detail of Markov Manor was painstakingly recreated, from the floating laser ghosts to the robot space gargoyles.
Putting the "oo" in "spooky" and the "fun" in "no refunds!"
"Sir, this may be the information booth, but I cannot answer ontological questions. It would be arrogant to assume I could describe the true nature of reality. Also there's a line."
Since the majority of the park's business model is based around aimless wandering, this is not where Myra stations her best people.
"When I arrived, I was looking for the costume shop. But when I left, I'd learned what I was really looking for: myself. Five stars." —*Salzon's Ride Review*
The information booth can answer over thirty-seven billion questions. Half the guests ask where the bathroom is.
The only ride that's never failed a safety inspection.
The only ride not explicitly mentioned in the Astrotorium waiver.
There's something truly thrilling about moving so slowly.
"The calming motion of this grubling's ride reminds me of my world's beauty before this mobile astropark obliterated it." —Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop
"The coaster was so gentle, I was able to write my review while I was still on it." —*Salzon's Ride Review*
"The ride is clearly inspired by the Kolaghan clan's reign on Tarkir which makes the use of Ojutai's scale pattern on the seats very disappointing." —Vorthos, Steward of Myth
"Keep your hands and feet inside me at all times and enjoy the glubbbbrbb! Glbbglubb! Glb!"
"Thanks for riding, and be sure not to leaf anything behind! Just some tree humor for you."
Ensconced in a slow time bubble that makes a five-minute ride take nine hours, the carousel is a very popular childcare option.
After the first rotation, the dressage phase begins.
Every rider leaves The Fluctuator happy—most because they're thrilled to still be alive.
They say you leave a piece of yourself behind on Garruk's Wake. The janitorial bots can tell you that's absolutely true.
The Time Spiral goes so fast it causes a paradox. Myra uses this opportunity to sell guests their souvenir photos while they're still waiting to board.
The Howling Mine moves faster than the speed of sound. The screams you hear are the group ahead of you.
"The ship spinning out of control was spot-on, but no one shouting, 'Nebula! You fell asleep again!' or openly weeping? Too unrealistic." —Captain Rex Nebula
"Expect to be out of commission for about a week. It's awesome." —*Salzon's Ride Review*
Located on the opposite side of the park from the food court, for obvious reasons.
There's no such thing as upside down in space. Put another way, there are infinite upside downs in space.
"If a species will pay to be moved in a circle, I will find a way to let it." —Myra the Magnificent
The maximum recommended speed warning system snapped off years ago, but they hadn't encountered problems yet.
The ride is whimsical and fun, except when it's broken.
You leave the ride either entertained or an elk. Usually the latter.
"I feel just like Kari Zev! Ragavan, set a course for Lathnu!" —Vorthos, Steward of Myth
"A good ride should always feel like something has gone terribly wrong." —*Salzon's Ride Review*
"I had to wrestle a squirrel for it, but I won!"
Yet another trash uncommon.
To be honest, it's not much dirtier than the ball pit.
Standing knee-deep in unsorted Astrotorium garbage, Gurnt couldn't help but feel his trip was finally starting to turn around.
Can it be Lightning Bolt yet?
The longest lines in the park.
Memories that will technically last the rest of your life.
"What could be funnier than one big pie to the face? Unless . . . no. Could it be that simple?" —Pietra, Crafter of Clowns
"Behold the power of my hat and the ghosts of two other hats I used to own!"
Not all tickets can be exchanged for prizes.
"'Carol, blast those aliens.' 'Carol, transport these concessions.' No one cares that today is my birthday."
With enough showmanship, even mundane items like playing cards or molecular teleporters can produce a mesmerizing spectacle.
"Control to Truss. Chief, the entry scan software is reading babies as hot dogs. Again." —Glaxxar, engineering assistant
"When riding Erebo's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."
The midway offers every flavor under the sun, even to guests who need to stay out of it.
"'Technologically-Advanced People-Pleasing Entertainment Robot', eh? Nice hat. Would be a shame if something happened to it." —"Brims" Barone, midway mobster
Tap beverages with extreme caution.
Cute as a mutton.
The Gargantikari astroserpent hated the taste of merfolk, but the audience didn't need to know that.
Lying to a fish is such an unthinkable act, most planets don't even have a law against it.
Sometimes the Astrotorium's stunts look dangerous because they absolutely are.
Before criticizing, walk a mile *(about 1.6 kilometers)* in their head. That way, when you do, you're a mile away and you have their head.
There are no small parts, only small performers.
Against the infinite backdrop of space, isn't all golf miniature?
paragraphs.card: How Is This a Par Three?!

paragraphs.text: Nine fires, a hull breach, and a Quafloovian meganibbler escaped from the petting zoo. Things were suspiciously quiet.
"That bear's been there since the Astrotorium opened. I've seen it move." —Ernst, deep fry cook
Fblthp decided to get some sleep, nestled among the plush Ajanis until morning.
"Glaxxar, Security Bot 254 has wandered off. After lunch, throw on a spacesuit and go find it." —Truss, chief engineer.
Magic is the name of the game.
Some people will hire anyone with a pulse. Myra isn't that picky.
Without vowels, no one can hear you scream.
The mirrors weren't fun for everyone.
Safety twelfth.
"Brims" Barone's enforcers are always dressed to kill.
May contain soy. May contain a deep void, chillingly hoarse and howling without voice. May contain gluten.
Myra doesn't believe in stopping rides for minor inconveniences like "they need to be repaired."
While the gremlin, beeble, and squirrel infestations wrecked havoc on the park, Roxi was able to spin the numerous rat colonies as a "robust recycling program."
The horrors of Sorin's Haunted Mansion scared Hurrk half to life.
"What? No, that's ridiculous! Of course the rat doesn't work for the park. I've never seen it before in my life!" —Monoxa, midway manager
"Ah, the midway, beating heart of the—well, maybe the big top is the heart. If there were two hearts then the midway—or the lungs. Lungs or stomach!" —Captain Rex Nebula
Space can be a lawless place—far from the praying eyes of electrical inspectors.
Employees were instructed to refer to meteor showers as "impromptu fireworks."
The results of the test of strength were: Yes.
Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.
"Danger is my middle name. Also, I don't know how to spell."
The midway's games aren't so much rigged as they are insulated and grounded.
The Astrotorium has never been a place for self-restraint.
The goblins really put themselves into the fireworks show, despite Myra's pleas to stop.
"If I ever need a haircut, I just fall a little to the left."
Designed for maximum impact, comedic and otherwise.
The Astrotorium's express lane is practically its own ride.
When she performed, she was on fire, but in a good way.
"Attention, valued patrons. The Tilt-o-Squirrel is now closed." —Astrotorium public address system
Silent, but deadly.
Whenever you copy a triggered ability, you may do a little dance.
"Just wait, my Madara deck isn't all Emperor Bolas. There's an Umezawa subtheme!"
"Whimsy overflow in sector G! The gremlins are rampaging and the beetles are on fire!"
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves." —Myra the Magnificent
When Captain Nebula tragically destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident, Myra compensated the survivors with lifetime passes.
The Astrotorium adds new attractions almost as fast as Captain Nebula can crash them into asteroids.
Her most popular flavors are vanilla, maple pecan crunch, and Glurgian galactopod.
"So sorry, but per our waiver, we're not responsible for 'things happening.'"
"Ach! Hans, run! Get the camera. He's adorable!" —Steffi Bobsdotter, next words
Calling it a "petting zoo" really saved on the cages.
The pie was outstanding. The cobbler tasted like shoes.
"If you've got words, we're going to have words."
This dinosaur doesn't know what will kill him, but he's determined it won't be heart disease.
Elven tap is the official language of three very obnoxious planets.
Impossibly tall, improbably elegant.
A sludge with a grudge.
"Can we get this ghost 11% spookier?"
It runs on laughing gas.
"I don't know you, but that hammer rings a bell."
"WE ARE FILLED WITH TICKETS. WE ARE FILLED WITH PURPOSE."
"Please do not engage in debates on the nature of reality with the robot staff." —Astrotorium sign
"Unless you're quicker, I wouldn't snicker."
